newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE-Russia inflation flat at 0.2 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Russia inflation flat at 0.2 pct in week.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated not to have changed in the week ended July 21 from 0.2 percent in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
If current price trends continue, monthly inflation for the whole of July will be 0.7 percent, the committee said. The monthly inflation rate in June was 1.1 percent.
The committee said if current price trends continue prices would have risen in the first seven months by 9.4 percent.
